Provenance for SampleDynamicBoundary.dll (checked in beside this file).
The .txt extension keeps the file out of both SDK source globbing and the
cs2j whole-tree compilation.

Rebuild (from the repository root):

  dotnet new classlib -n SampleDynamicBoundary -o $tmp -f netstandard2.0
  # overwrite Class1.cs with the source below, then:
  dotnet build $tmp/SampleDynamicBoundary.csproj -c Release
  copy $tmp/bin/Release/netstandard2.0/SampleDynamicBoundary.dll ^
       tests/SampleDynamicDesugarSolution/SampleDynamicDesugarLib/external/

The bodies perform no dynamic binding on purpose: netstandard2.0 needs the
Microsoft.CSharp package only for dynamic call sites, and the fixture only
needs the object + [DynamicAttribute] metadata shape.

----- source -----
namespace SampleDynamicBoundary
{
    public static class DynamicShapes
    {
        public static dynamic Echo(object value) => value;

        public static string Format(dynamic value) => string.Empty;

        public static dynamic Value { get; set; }
    }
}
